name: Hybrid Grids
definition: A rendering strategy combining a shallow k-d tree with a global grid of macro cells to perform full ray traversal until a k-d tree leaf is found, then using the global grid for finer-grained empty space skipping.
summary: Hybrid Grids combines a shallow k-d tree with a global grid to decouple tree depth from skipping granularity, enabling faster construction and finer empty-space detection than pure hierarchical structures.
